name: Ellis County, KS
findings: Ellis County has 123 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ellis County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
